lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for most specific change types because only choose_path copy and home wait_info have at least two tests.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse across multiple tests.
Waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Redesigning friend selection (adoption, redesign) and reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) were helpful, winning their tests.
Layout changes, notification toggles, and new visual tip screens had no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

candidates.title: Split layout sign-in screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a split layout to clearly separate authentication options from pet progress context.
candidates.why: Sign-in step has 76.0% conversion, and 2 support emails reported app stalling or sign-in screens failing to load properly.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Access Your Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to finish setting up your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the sign-in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 24% of users with 2 support mails; redesigning sign-in layout has moderate potential.

candidates.title: Pet naming screen before account setup
candidates.change: Add a new screen after adoption certificate where users enter and confirm their pet's name before proceeding to sign-in.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 30.2% of users with an 89s median time; introducing a quick naming step boosts ownership before account creation.

new_pet_name.headline: Name Your Pet
new_pet_name.body: Choose a name for your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet naming screen inside the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens tends to increase friction; past new_screen test reduced conversion by -2.6%.

candidates.title: Photo quality guideline hint on photo upload screen
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint and quality badge to the photo upload screen explaining best photo lighting and angles.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned custom pet creation failing or looking wrong after photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit frontal photos for accurate pet generation results.

guard.reason: Valid addition of quality guidelines to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from 3 support emails on custom pet failures; cheap config/hint change.

candidates.title: Interactive wait screen animation replace
candidates.change: Replace the standard wait status with a custom progress and live companion preview component.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) with an 18.7% dropoff rate before entering home.

guard.reason: Valid replacement of wait status components while maintaining the waiting screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lowest dropoff (18.7%) and wait_info showed little effect (+0.6%); high build cost.

candidates.title: Desktop control hint on finish screen
candidates.change: Add a hint to the final home intro screen explaining basic mouse controls and right-click actions for the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open control options, speak, or send it to sleep.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a control hint to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish screen has the highest dropoff (35.2%) and 3 support emails; cheap hint fix.

candidates.change: Redesign the onboarding story screen to a story_scroll layout to improve narrative engagement.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users, and layout redesigns have proven more effective than pure copy edits in earlier tests.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path step drops 23.8%; copy edits failed previously (-4.1%), layout redesign is unproven.

candidates.change: Insert a new screen before home intro showing users where the pet sits on screen and how desktop launch works.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app not opening, while 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a desktop guide screen inside the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence, but inserting a new screen previously decreased finish conversion.

candidates.why: Waiting screen mean duration is 2336s (median 201s), causing users to switch away and forget the desktop app.

components.label: Play chime when pet is ready

candidates.score_note: Home notification test had positive trend (+2.7%) and low cost, though home dropoff is lower.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for single-test kinds of changes (adoption layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, sign_in redesign, sign_in reorder).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) consistently worked well and proved helpful.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse.
Notification toggles (home, notification) and waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no clear positive effect and hurt performance.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.
